messages:
Maria: quick sync — rehearsal tomorrow 9:30am PT. run-of-show draft below, need signoff on fallback plan and lead routing mapping. @here

Maria: run-of-show (short):
- 0:00 intro (Maria)
- 2:30 benchmark narrative + why cost/latency matter (Josh)
- 10:00 live demo: hosted -> dedicated failover (Ezra)
- 18:00 audience q&a / routing to HubSpot form (Priya)
- 25:00 closing

Josh: looks good. for the demo I want the ability to switch model variant quickly if latency spikes. propose primary = redwood/v1-small, fallback = redwood/v1-medium-quant. can we pre-warm the dedicated pool before go-live?

Ezra: yes, we can warm GPUs 10m before. also adding an automated fallback policy in the demo harness so if p95 > 600ms we switch. bringing the exact switch command to rehearsal.

Priya: for lead routing — the CTA goes to a short form. mapping: webinar_source=webinar_march, interest=hosting_option (hosted/dedicated/private). HubSpot property names: hs_webinar_source, hs_inferred_interest. We'll need the panelist utm tagging for campaign reports.

Maria: perfect. can someone paste the switch command here so ops can copy into rehearsal script?

Ezra: paste below — this is what I run from the demo machine (local auth token injected):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/switch-model \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"demo-live","model":"redwood/v1-medium-quant","reason":"fallback_latency"}'
```

Ezra: the command returns a 200 and the routing table updates within ~2s. fallback will preserve session KV if fallback-compatible model is used.

Josh: note — quantized variant changes some tokens; we'll add a disclaimer slide for subtle generation diffs. keep the example prompts simple.

Priya: for HubSpot, I'll add a hidden field on the form with model_demo_variant so we can analyze interest vs variant. also adding a workflow to add these leads to the 'webinar - demo attendees' list and tag by interest.

Maria: contingency checklist for rehearsal:
- network: confirm greenroom VPN (Ezra)
- pre-warm: done 10m prior (ops)
- permission: deploy token scoping read+route change (Security)
- recording: Otter.ai + internal recording (Priya)
- slide 6: add benchmark caveat (Josh)

Josh: I'll trim the benchmark slide to 2 bullets and add the caveat note.

DeployBot: Deploy notice — dedicated-pool prewarm scheduled at 2026-03-24T09:20:00Z for demo-live (initiated by Ezra). :white_check_mark:

Priya: rehearsal ask — can someone own the live chat triage during q&a? need quick answers about pricing vs SLA. Maria, can you own that or should I?

Maria: I can own live chat triage. Priya please feed me the one-pagers for pricing and Dedicated commitments.

Priya: done — uploaded to the rehearsal folder. link: https://redwood.share/rehearsal/mar-webinar (shortlink)

Ezra: one more: record the command that forces fallback back to primary (for demo reset):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/switch-model \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"demo-live","model":"redwood/v1-small","reason":"reset_after_demo"}'
```

Maria: awesome. last thing — captions on, start recording at 9:25. see you all tomorrow, please be in greenroom 9:10. :rocket:
